# fastapi-fullauth

> Production-grade, async-native authentication and authorization library for FastAPI.

FastAPI FullAuth is a pluggable authentication and authorization library for FastAPI. It provides JWT access and refresh tokens with rotation and reuse detection (stored as sha256 digests), password hashing (Argon2id or bcrypt), email verification and password reset flows, OAuth2 social login (Google, GitHub, Discord, GitLab, or custom providers via StandardOAuthProvider), passkey (WebAuthn) login, session management, role-based access control with permissions, rate limiting, CSRF protection, and security headers middleware. Anti-enumeration and timing-attack defenses are on by default. Adapters handle storage (SQLModel, SQLAlchemy, Tortoise ORM, or Beanie/MongoDB), backends handle token extraction, flows implement auth logic, and composable routers expose the API. Configuration uses Pydantic Settings with environment variable support. Custom user schemas are generic, including the user primary key type: UUID by default, UserSchema[int] or UserSchema[str] otherwise. Source: https://github.com/mdfarhankc/fastapi-fullauth. PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/fastapi-fullauth/. Python 3.10 to 3.14, MIT licensed. Coding agents can install the Agent Skill with: npx skills add mdfarhankc/fastapi-fullauth

## Getting started

- [Home](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/index.md): Overview, features, installation, quick start example, route table, and composable routers
- [Getting Started](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/getting-started/index.md): Step-by-step setup with user model, database, FullAuth config, FastAPI wiring, and first API calls
- [Migrating from fastapi-users](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/migrating-from-fastapi-users/index.md): Moving an existing fastapi-users app across; concept and route mapping, password hashes carry over, data migration SQL, and client changes
- [Architecture](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/architecture/index.md): How the library works internally; adapters, backends, flows, routers, and protection layers
- [Configuration](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/configuration/index.md): All FullAuthConfig options; core, tokens, passwords, login, rate limiting, Redis, blacklist, cookies, OAuth, routing
- [Customization](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/customization/index.md): Map of every extension point; custom adapters, user schemas, token claims, event hooks, password rules, token transport, route selection
- [Recipes](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/recipes/index.md): End-to-end examples combining customization seams, such as multi-tenant SaaS and username-based login

## Adapters

- [Overview](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/adapters/index.md): Adapter architecture, choosing an adapter, custom schemas, and choosing a primary key type (UUID, int, str)
- [SQLModel](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/adapters/sqlmodel/index.md): SQLModel adapter setup with UserMixin fields, session configuration, table schema, custom schemas, and OAuth support
- [SQLAlchemy](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/adapters/sqlalchemy/index.md): SQLAlchemy declarative adapter setup with user model, table creation, and custom schemas
- [Tortoise ORM](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/adapters/tortoise/index.md): Tortoise ORM adapter with model mixins, Tortoise.init registration, real transactions, and custom schemas
- [Beanie (MongoDB)](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/adapters/beanie/index.md): Beanie (MongoDB) adapter with document classes, init_beanie, embedded roles/permissions, and single-document CAS atomicity
- [Custom Adapters](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/adapters/custom/index.md): Worked in-memory adapter example, key method contracts (revoke CAS, transaction, sign-count), and opting into features

## Authentication

- [Protected Routes](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/auth/dependencies/index.md): current_user, verified and superuser dependencies, current_token_payload, require_role, require_permission, typed dependencies
- [Session Management](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/auth/sessions/index.md): List active sessions (refresh-token families), revoke one device, or sign out everywhere else
- [Event Hooks](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/auth/hooks/index.md): Callbacks for auth events such as after_register, after_login, send_verification_email, after_oauth_login
- [Custom Token Claims](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/auth/custom-claims/index.md): Embed app-specific data in JWTs via on_create_token_claims, read through payload.extra
- [Password Validation](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/auth/passwords/index.md): Custom password rules, hashing algorithms, and transparent rehashing
- [Passkeys (WebAuthn)](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/passkeys/index.md): WebAuthn passwordless login; registration and authentication flows, clone detection, frontend integration
- [OAuth2 Social Login](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/oauth/index.md): Google, GitHub, Discord, and GitLab OAuth setup, authorization flow, auto-linking by email, unlinking, custom providers

## Security

- [Rate Limiting](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/security/rate-limiting/index.md): Per-route auth limits and global IP-based rate limiting with memory or Redis backends
- [Middleware](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/security/middleware/index.md): Security headers and CSRF double-submit cookie protection, added with app.add_middleware
- [Threat Model](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/security/threat-model/index.md): What the library defends against, its trust assumptions, failure modes, and what remains the application's responsibility

## Operations

- [Frontend Integration](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/frontend-integration/index.md): Wiring auth into a frontend; token storage, refresh handling, and protected requests
- [Database Migrations](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/migrations/index.md): Alembic env.py wiring with your project's metadata and opt-in tables via mixin subclassing
- [Testing](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/testing/index.md): Testing apps built with fastapi-fullauth; fixtures, overriding dependencies, asserting auth behavior
- [Troubleshooting](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/troubleshooting/index.md): Common errors and warnings mapped to fixes
- [API Reference](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/api-reference/index.md): FullAuth, FullAuthConfig, types, dependencies, exceptions, and utilities
- [Contributing](https://mdfarhankc.github.io/fastapi-fullauth/contributing/index.md): Development setup, testing, linting, and contribution guidelines
